description: Test file for the Endpointslice Mirroring Controller in Kubernetes, containing unit tests for the reconcile logic of EndpointSlices based on Endpoints objects, including various scenarios of address, port, annotations, and owner references.

methods.name: newReconciler
methods.description: Creates a new reconciler instance with provided context, client, and max endpoints per subset.

methods.name: expectEndpointSlices
methods.description: Validates the number and properties of EndpointSlices against expectations.

methods.name: portsMatch
methods.description: Checks if EndpointPort slices match in name, port, protocol, and appProtocol.

methods.name: expectMatchingAddresses
methods.description: Verifies that EndpointSlice endpoints match the expected addresses, readiness, hostname, and nodeName.

methods.name: fetchEndpointSlices
methods.description: Retrieves EndpointSlices from the fake client for a given namespace.

methods.name: reconcileHelper
methods.description: Helper to invoke the reconcile method and check for errors.

methods.name: expectMetrics
methods.description: Checks that the metrics match expected values.

methods.name: handleErr
methods.description: Handles errors during metric checks, reporting failures.

methods.name: setupMetrics
methods.description: Initializes and resets metrics for testing.
